title: Weak and strong normalization in pure type systems

issues.description: A sanity check of the graph exclusion, not a confirmed gap. The 3-sort specification *:□:△ with rules (□,□,□), (△,□,□), (□,*,*), (*,□,□) (λU⁻ without (*,*), plus (*,□)) has a third-case primary component S={{*},{□}} that satisfies the forbidden configuration (C={{□}}, s=□, triple ({△},{□},{□})). So Prop. enc-exclusion implies this system is not weakly normalizing. This is a nonstandard claim that the paper should probably state or illustrate, because the system has no (*,*) rule. My first attempt to show the system is SN failed: the alternating (*,□) and (□,*) wrappers plus kind-level impredicativity appear to support a double-negation encoding of Hurkens's paradox. So I do not regard it as a counterexample.
issues.evidence: Python script (/tmp/pts339/g.py) builds the primary and secondary graphs and checks the forbidden configuration. For this system it reports FORBIDDEN in S=[{B},{*}], C=[{B}], s=B, triple {T},{B},{B}. The configuration is absent for CC, F, Fω, λHOL, CC with 2–3 universes, and ~20k random specifications that map into ECC_4 (all SN). It is present for λ*, λU and λU⁻.

coverage: Read closely: introduction, metatheory (Sec. 2), profiles/candidate interface (lemma sn-fundamental, Props advance-component and interfaces-imply-sn), the signed Tarski construction, the one-child bit construction and its substitution comparison lemma, the observation spaces (plain potential argument p_C, free alternating chain, uniform finite-bound lemma, goodness, substitution, reduction transport, interface theorem), the wrappers/formula calculus, and the no-normal-erasure lemma plus exclusion proposition. Only skimmed or spot-checked: channels.tex and most of relational.tex (the ~2000-line relational Hurkens encoding). The final diagonal proposition is logically sound if its lemmas hold. Computation: implemented the profile, secondary-graph and forbidden-configuration definitions and tested them against known SN and known non-normalizing PTSs, with random sub-specifications of ECC_4. No disagreement with known results.
main_claim: Every weakly β-normalizing pure type system (arbitrary, possibly nonfunctional specification; full β including annotations; open contexts) is strongly β-normalizing — the β-Barendregt–Geuvers–Klop conjecture.
